Context: (g) LTC during study leave.-

When not residing at the place of study leave reimbursement will be as under normal rules. - GID (17), Rule 7.  
- (h) LTC during suspension.If an official is under suspension, he cannot avail LTC but his family can avail LTC. - GID (20), Rule 7.
- (i) LTC during LPR.LTC to home town and any place in India will be allowed, provided the return journey is completed before the expiry of leave preparatory to retirement. - GID (21), Rule 7.
